description.en: Lightweight and modular UI components engineered for maximum website performance.
description.zh: 追求极致轻量体积与加载性能的模块化 React 基础控件库。

content.en: Ninja UI delivers agile, zero-fluff React components designed to keep bundle sizes minuscule. Perfect for speed-critical web applications, it provides essential form inputs, tooltips, and modal cards with clean styling and smooth micro-interactions.
content.zh: Ninja UI 是一套专注于极致精简与高响应性能的 React 组件库。为满足对页面加载速度有严苛要求的现代应用而设计，它剔除冗余依赖，提供纯粹干净的表单输入、浮层提示与模态卡片，保持瞬时响应与高渲染帧率。
